termsSections.title: 1. General provisions
termsSections.content: These terms set out how FastDo may be used. Using the application means accepting them.

termsSections.title: 2. User account
termsSections.content: Authentication is handled by an external identity provider. You are responsible for keeping your sign-in details confidential.
items: Accounts are personal and must not be shared.

termsSections.title: 3. Scope of the service
termsSections.content: The application is for running projects and tasks. It is provided as-is, with no guarantee of uninterrupted availability.

termsSections.title: 4. Responsibility
termsSections.content: You are responsible for the content you put into the application and for the consequences of sharing it with other project members.

termsSections.title: 5. Changes to these terms
termsSections.content: Users are notified of changes in advance. Continuing to use the application after they take effect means accepting them.

privacyPolicySections.title: 1. Data controller
privacyPolicySections.content: The owner of the service is the controller of the personal data processed in FastDo.

privacyPolicySections.title: 2. What is processed
privacyPolicySections.content: Only the data needed to provide the service is processed.
items: The e-mail address and name on the account.

privacyPolicySections.title: 3. Purpose and legal basis
privacyPolicySections.content: Data is processed to provide the service, on the basis of the agreement formed by accepting these terms.

privacyPolicySections.title: 4. Your rights
privacyPolicySections.content: You may access, correct, erase and export your data.
items: Account deletion requests are acted on without delay.
A copy of your data is provided on request.

privacyPolicySections.title: 5. Retention
privacyPolicySections.content: Data is kept for as long as the account exists, and afterwards only for the period the law requires.
